title: bromus diandrus subsp. maximus
intro: Bromus diandrus subsp. maximus, commonly known as Greater False Brome, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Greater False Brome have been found to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various conditions, highlighting its value as a medicinal plant.
